content.summary: Review of Provider Quota Widget: PASS - All acceptance criteria met

findings.issue: Helper functions (isRecord, stringFrom, numberFrom, dateFrom, percentFrom) provide defensive parsing
findings.suggestion: Well-designed pattern - consider extracting to shared utility if reused elsewhere

findings.issue: Reference equality check `data === entry.data` will always be false for fresh fetches
findings.suggestion: Harmless but could be removed for clarity

findings.issue: Module-level cache Map follows project singleton patterns

code.summary: Code quality is excellent. Follows all project conventions: no let, no try/catch, const with early returns, type-safe (no any). Passes typecheck.

security.summary: No security issues. Auth tokens handled correctly via Authorization headers. No sensitive data in logs (only providerID, status, url). Hardcoded URLs prevent injection.

findings.issue: Inline IIFE with formatting logic inside declarative JSX
findings.suggestion: Could extract to <QuotaDisplay info={...} /> component for separation of concerns

findings.issue: Module-level mutable cache singleton creates implicit shared state
findings.suggestion: Acceptable for MVP TUI widget - would need refactoring for testability at scale

findings.issue: Provider-specific business logic is complected with HTTP fetching
findings.suggestion: Consider QuotaProvider interface in future to separate implementations from caching layer

simplicity.summary: Implementation has typical MVP braids. UI mixes formatting with structure, data layer mixes fetching/parsing/caching. All non-blocking and acceptable for initial implementation.

requirements.summary: All acceptance criteria from all three work items are met. The previous blocking issue (widget not using fetchCached) has been fixed.

suggestions.issue: IIFE in JSX (sidebar.tsx:165-190) could be extracted to component
suggestions.impact: Improves readability and testability but not blocking

suggestions.issue: Add more error case tests for Anthropic/OpenRouter fetchers
suggestions.impact: Improves test coverage but core functionality is tested

suggestions.issue: Remove unnecessary reference equality check in fetchCached (line 241)

trace_report.original_problem: Users need visibility into their API quota usage from the TUI sidebar
trace_report.chosen_option: Minimal sidebar widget with service abstraction (from commit plan)
trace_report.learning_milestone: Validate quota display UX and API integration patterns
acceptance_criteria_met: quota-service.md: ProviderQuota namespace created with fetch() for Anthropic/OpenRouter
quota-service.md: QuotaInfo type with all required fields (type, remaining, resetsAt, weeklyUsed, weeklyLimit, totalCredits)
quota-service.md: Returns null for unsupported providers without throwing
quota-service.md: Uses existing Auth.get() for tokens correctly
quota-widget.md: Widget displays usage percentage with provider name
quota-widget.md: Widget displays reset time with relative formatting (Xh Ym)
quota-widget.md: Widget displays weekly cost for pay-as-you-go providers
quota-widget.md: Integrated after Context section in sidebar
quota-widget.md: Uses theme system (success/warning/error colors based on remaining %)
quota-widget.md: Reactively updates on provider/message changes (via on() tracking)
quota-widget.md: Shows '...' during loading, '--' when unavailable
quota-cache.md: In-memory cache with 60s TTL implemented (Map + TTL constant)
quota-cache.md: fetchCached() returns cached data if within TTL
quota-cache.md: Cache hit/miss logging via Log.create({ service: 'provider-quota' })
quota-cache.md: Error handling never throws - uses .catch(() => null) pattern
quota-cache.md: Rate limit (429) returns cached fallback data

details: quota module exports ProviderQuota and QuotaInfo
fetch returns null for unsupported provider
tests.coverage: Core cache behavior tested. Edge cases for unsupported providers covered. Could add more error scenario tests.
